newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CityDev gets nod for Sydney apartments.
newsitem.headline: CityDev gets nod for Sydney apartments.

text.p: City Developments Ltd (CDL) said on Monday it had obtained approval to launch an Australian $85 million residential project in Sydney.

It said in a statement the 331-unit development located on the waterfront on Iron Cove in Sydney's inner harbour was approved by the city's Drummoyne City Council and will be part of CDL's existing Birkenhead Point development.
Approval of the final form of the application came just before Christmas, after a seven-year battle over development proposals, it said.
It said sale of the apartments was scheduled for March, and construction would begin in April. Prices range from A$235,000 to A$825,000. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
